mostWorthwhile.text: Fermenting the food remainder was most worthwhile: it connected fibre that human enzymes leave behind to microbial fatty acids and gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the fermenting contents to the body repeated much of the fermentation picture; the fatty acids’ use was only explained in the final result.

surprise.text: Some microbial fatty acids enter colon lining cells and can be used by them, while some reach the blood.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless. Adding mucus was the only offered combination at that point, but its protective role became clear in the result.

continue.text: I would continue: the concise construction connected microbial activity to human physiology, although I would want more explanation of how the fatty acids are used.
